meta.title: Leaf Digital — Shopify Apps That Find Money in the Gaps
meta.description: Your Shopify, your 3PL, and your spreadsheet all tell a different story. Leaf makes small, sharp Shopify apps that find the money hiding in the gaps — and then do the work.

hero.headline:
Your money

is hiding.
hero.subhead: Your Shopify, your 3PL, and your spreadsheet all tell a different story. And the money hides in the gaps.
hero.finePrint: Our first app is live: Image Voice, the silent-images scan. Three more are in the lab — Ledger, 3PL Bill Check and Inventory Runway. First in line hears first.

inventory.title: Inventory on hand · same SKU set, same day
inventory.caption: Ledger — in the lab. Three numbers in three places; this is the gap it keeps, PO by PO. <link>→</link>

villain.title: You check three dashboards and still don’t know which number is real.
villain.sub: You didn’t build a brand for this. The failure is never a feature — it’s the seams. Nobody holds the map, so the money hides between systems.
villain.one: Cash locked in inventory nobody meant to order
villain.two: Sales lost to stockouts no system ever records
villain.three: Refund waves colliding with PO deposits you can’t see coming
villain.four: Sync breaks discovered months too late
villain.closer: Everything expensive is invisible. That’s the villain — and it’s why no single dashboard has ever caught it.

plan.title: Three steps between you and the hidden money

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Leaf links your systems and shows you, in dollars, where they disagree. No opinions — arithmetic.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.body: 30 days of “here’s exactly what I would have done.” Money caught, proof on paper — your store is the case study.

run.title: Let it run
run.body: One-click approvals, then set your threshold and get your time back. Autonomy is earned, never assumed.

suite.title: The plan, made real
suite.sub: Small, sharp apps. Each one finds money in a specific seam — then does the work itself.

imageVoice.description: Your images are silent — to Google, to AI shoppers, to screen readers. Free scan, a real description for every image.

ledger.description: You paid for 1,000. 980 landed. Nobody counted. Ledger keeps the PO tracker from the documents themselves — ordered, billed, landed, what each unit really cost.

billCheck.description: Your 3PL overbilled you. Nobody caught it. Forward last month’s invoice and get back the lines that don’t match what you agreed to pay — priced, the same day, free.

runway.description: Your best seller goes out and nobody tells you. One list a week: what’s running out, when, and how much to order.

contrast.withoutBody: The quarter ends the way it always does: “where did the money go?” Another night of spreadsheets, another set of numbers that don’t tie out.
contrast.withBody: You open one email a week, watch the numbers tie out, and go back to building the thing you started the company to build.

cta.title: Ledger is in the lab. Send ten POs and see what landed.
cta.sub: We won’t show you someone else’s numbers. We’ll show you yours — your last ten POs, ordered, billed and landed, side by side, in about 30 minutes. Free, and the findings are yours either way.
